# appgatesdp_file (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filename` (String) The filename to save the File as.
- `url` (String) The URL for Controller to download the File from.

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.

### Read-Only

- `checksum` (String) SHA256 checksum of the File.
- `creation_time` (String) The creation time of the File.
- `failure_reason` (String) The reason of failure.
- `last_modified_time` (String) The last modified time of the File.
- `name` (String) Filename.
- `status` (String) Status of the File.
